# DIABETES-RELATED FOOT INFECTIONS (DIABETIC FOOT INFECTIONS-DFI)

# Wound Cultures:

If there are no systemic symptoms of infection or at least 2 local symptoms (pain, erythema > 0.5cm, purulent drainage, warmth), do not culture or treat with abx.

Do NOT:

- Culture a wound that appears uninfected (at least 2 of following: local pain, erythema >0.5cm, purulent drainage)
- Swab the wound to obtain a culture
- Culture without first cleaning and debriding a wound DFI Do:
- Obtain culture by deep tissue biopsy after cleaning and debriding the wound

# Imaging:

- An x-ray is recommended for all new foot ulcers in patients with diabetes to evaluate for deformity, bony destruction, soft tissue gas, and/or foreign bodies. Antimicrobials aren't indicated unless local cellulitis or systemic infectious symptoms are present.

[Click here for Osteomyelitis Evaluation](osteomyelitis-evaluation)

# INFECTION SEVERITY (IWGDF/IDSA Classification)

---

# Uninfected DFI (Class 1/Uninfected): Chronic ulceration without s/s infection

- if no pain, erythema > 0.5cm, purulent drainage, do not culture or treat Do not culture wound -Do not treat with antibiotics If osteomyelitis identified arrange for bone biopsy --hold antibiotics

---

# Infected DFI (Class 2/Mild):

At least two of the following are present: -Local swelling or induration

- Erythema >0.5cm but <2cm around wound -Local tenderness or pain -Local increased warmth -Purulent drainage

## Inpatient

### Primarily Outpatient Treatment:

Duration of therapy: 1-2 weeks

### Preferred Regimens:

[Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h x 7 days R](psjzid-cefadroxil-1000mg-po-q12h)
< OR >
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID for 7 days R](psjzid-amox-clav-875-125mg-po-q12h)

### Treatment with previous MRSA infection or severe PCN allergy:

[Beta-lactam Reaction Assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO bid x 7 days R,DI](psjzid-trimeth-sulfa-1-ds-tab-bid)
< OR >
[Linezolid 600 mg PO BID for 7 days DI,O](psjzid-linezolid-600mg-po-q12h)

### Infected DFI (Class 3/Moderate):

- Erythema extending >2cm from the wound margin, and/or -Tissue deeper than skin and subcutaneous tissues (e.g., tendon, muscle, joint, and bone)

### Outpatient/Often Hospitalized Treatment:

Oral or IV with change to PO with improvement
Duration of therapy: 1-3 weeks

### Preferred Treatments:

[Amoxicillin/clavulanate 875/125mg po bid R for 7 days](psjzid-amox-clav-875-125mg-po-q12h)

### Treatment with history of previous MRSA infection:

[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg po BID R <AND> doxycycline](orz-set-abx-amox-clav-875-q12h-doxycycline-100mg-q12h)
100 mg PO bid [DI] for 7 days
< OR >
[Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125mg PO bid R <AND> trimethoprim-](orz-set-abx-amox-clav-875-po-q12h-trimeth-sulfa-1ds-po-q12)
sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO bid [R,DI] for 7 days

### Intravenous regimens with MRSA coverage: if previous history of MRSA

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h M < AND > vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h R](orz-set-abx-ceft-2gm-iv-q24h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)
< OR >
[Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV q6h R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R,DI](orz-set-abx-ampi-sulb-3gm-iv-q6h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

### Treatment with Severe PCN allergy:

[Beta-lactam Allergy Assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Levofloxacin 500mg PO qday R,DI <AND> metronidazole 500mg PO bid DI](orz-set-abx-levoflox-500mg-qd-metro-500mg)
for 7 days

### Infected DFI (Class 4/Severe):

Infection with associated systemic manifestations as indicated by 2 or more of the following: -Fever, Tachycardia, Leukocytosis, Hypotension, Sepsis, Necrotizing infection
Duration: usually 2-4 weeks, unless source control/amputation occurs Obtain cultures of inflamed ulcer or wound to permit targeted antimicrobial therapy, de-escalate/modify regimen based on culture and susceptibility data. A switch to an oral regimen is reasonable
Preferred:

[Piperacillin-tazobactam 3.375 gm IV q6h R <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg](orz-set-abx-pip-taz3-375gm-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro-vanc15mg-kg)
IV q12h [R,DI]

< OR >
[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R,DI <AND>](orz-set-abx-cefe2gmivq8h-metro500mgivq8h-vanco15mg-kgivq12hstat)
metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]

Alternative:

[Beta-lactam Reaction Assessment](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q8h R <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h DI <AND>](orz-set-abx-ciprofl-400mg-iv-q8h-metroni-vanco)
vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h [R]
